_doc: ONE mod, ONE zip, ONE ini for every Windows PC and every Linux/Proton device (Steam Deck, Linux desktops, other handhelds).
make_profiles.py applies these overrides to mod\Nioh3EngineFix\Nioh3EngineFix.ini (comments kept) -> release\profiles\Nioh3EngineFix.<NAME>.ini; package.py writes Nioh3EngineFix-<ver>.zip.

A key whose best value differs by OS is '-1 = auto by OS' (ASI branch osauto; resolved at startup with wine_get_version, like SR/EP). The 'why' says where each side was MEASURED, never that it only works there.
status: kept = measured and safe as a default; provisional = recommended, live A/B still open (flip to kept/drop after the final re-test); off = deliberately off (measured loss, neutral, or opt-in).
'optin' lists keys that stay off by default but are documented for users who want them (shown in PROFILE.txt, not applied).
Edit when a matrix verdict lands (tools\testmatrix verdict_*.md), then run make_profiles.py and check_release.py. package.py --final refuses any 'provisional' entry.

ALL.title: All devices: Windows PC and Linux/Proton (Steam Deck, Linux desktop, handhelds) - OS-dependent keys are -1 = auto by OS

auto: Proton 1 (bit-exact, CPU power only; not yet run on a handheld), Windows 0 (measured on RX 9070 PC 2026-10-08 abba2 run5: no gain)
auto: Proton 3 (WinMain pump polls ~890/s at 1 ms; cpu-hotspots-ally.md row 4; not A/B tested), Windows 1 (stock)

auto = on (load windows) under Proton; Ally R2 ABBA 47.25 -> 38.45 s, 0 failures (1.7.25); off on Windows

page-pool sweep every 4th frame: PC +5.3 % (one window), texture-sharpness gate still open; staleness argument weak at 16-30 fps (Ally). Opt-in

handheld/power-limited opt-in only: cap 10 on a 16-thread APU cuts the weighted pools 127 -> 78 threads (job-system.md WC); costs parallel width on a 6c/12t desktop CPU and the Deck (8 threads) is already at stock <= cap

skip byte-identical per-draw constant uploads (same command list): pc2 CPU-bound on its slow chipset PCIe link +15.6 % (CBU1 #1609, ABBA x3, SE 0.07), offline byte-exact vs stock; Ally Proton/RADV no-harm (clean CBU-A1 rerun #1668: CBMODE 0/6 -0.16 % +- 0.16, no faults, no visible difference); PC RX 9070 no-harm A/B cbu2pc

with CBN: reuse the stage's CBV table of the same list when nothing changed; pc2 on its slow chipset PCIe link: CBN+CBT +15.9 % (CBU1 #1609, +0.1 fps over CBN alone); Ally Proton/RADV no-harm (CBU-A1 rerun #1668)
measured -7 % on PC (results_pc_1716.md); RADV already merges barriers on Proton (R2a/R1 trace work only)
